title: Daily Market Digest
subtitle: Markets Closed Today - Recap of Friday, July 31, 2026 Session

items.headline: U.S. Stocks Rally to Close July, Fueled by Amazon's Strong Earnings
items.summary: U.S. equities finished Friday, July 31, 2026, on a high note, wrapping up a volatile month. Amazon's robust earnings report eased concerns over AI spending, propelling major indices higher. However, Apple's disappointing forecast weighed on the tech giant, while climbing Treasury yields underscored persistent inflation worries.

items.headline: Amazon Surges on Strong Q2 Earnings
items.summary: Amazon ($AMZN) jumped 15.3% to approximately $271.58 after reporting better-than-expected Q2 profit and revenue, driven by accelerated growth in its cloud computing division (AWS) and significant AI investments.

items.headline: DexCom Climbs Amid Positive Sentiment
items.summary: DexCom, Inc. ($DXCM) rose 11.95%, contributing to the day's gains.

items.headline: Apple Drops on Weak Revenue Outlook
items.summary: Apple ($AAPL) fell 7.35% to around $308.91 after providing a lackluster forecast for upcoming revenue growth and reporting weaker-than-expected performance in its Services and China segments.

items.headline: Corteva Misses Q2 Revenue Estimates
items.summary: Corteva ($CTVA) declined 11.90% following its quarterly revenue miss, impacting the broader Materials sector.

items.headline: Consumer Discretionary Leads, Materials Lag Amid Earnings
items.summary: The Consumer Discretionary sector was the strongest performer, gaining 6.07% driven largely by Amazon's earnings beat. Conversely, the Materials sector was the worst performer, falling 2.71%, with companies like Corteva and Linde experiencing significant declines after their earnings reports.

items.headline: Q2 GDP Slows to 1.5%; Employment Costs Rise Moderately
items.summary: The U.S. economy expanded at an annualized rate of 1.5% in the second quarter of 2026, a slowdown from the first quarter's 2.1%. Despite the deceleration, underlying demand remained resilient. Separately, the Employment Cost Index (ECI) for June 2026 showed that compensation costs for civilian workers increased 0.9% for the three-month period ending in June.

items.headline: Treasury Yields Climb as Inflation Worries Persist Despite Fed Hold
items.summary: Treasury yields rose on Friday as concerns about persistent inflation continued to build in the bond market. This occurred even after the Federal Reserve opted to keep its main interest rate steady earlier in the week, with inflation remaining above the 2% target. The 10-year Treasury note notably reached 4.737%.

items.headline: S&P 500 Q2 Earnings Season Shows Strong Performance
items.summary: More than halfway through the Q2 earnings season, 86% of S&P 500 companies have reported earnings above estimates, and 77% have reported revenues above estimates. The aggregate earnings growth rate stands at 47.4%, or 28.8% excluding the significant contributions from Alphabet and Amazon.
